title: Vice
prompt: A labelled teaching model of the page 64 vice grips a wood specimen between a fixed plate and moving plate. Close rotates the handle and screw through the fixed threaded support, advancing the moving plate along the single guide rod. Tighten continues until contact and shows increasing clamping force without passing through the specimen. Open reverses the screw and releases it. See-through exposes the threaded support, screw, moving-jaw connection, guide rod and contact faces. Force is an overlay. Do not add quick-release gearing, a swivel base or extra guide mechanisms.
chapter: Part 1: The Mechanics of Movement / Screws
blurb: A teaching adaptation of the page 64 screw vice grips wood with one guided moving plate and an illustrative force overlay.
truthNotes: Scale teaching adaptation, not a literal book reproduction.
One guide rod. Fixed threaded support and captive moving-jaw connection.
Bench board and fixed-plate attachment are teaching fixtures; wood is a specimen.
Enlarged thread and slowed hand-driven motion. Force is a normalized illustration, not a measurement. Motion stops at contact; elastic strain is not drawn.
1998 page text and 2016 saved page scan support the mechanism. 1988 remains inaccessible and unverified. No edition-union claim.
